modules.name: GitHub organisation, source control and delivery
modules.goal: Preserve v0.1 as a recoverable baseline and create an accountable multi-person GitHub workflow.
modules.workflow: Founders select an organisation-owned private repo; enable MFA, at least two recovery-capable org owners, branch rules, CODEOWNERS, mandatory reviews, automated tests and release tags. Each PR names its source and any required human decision.
modules.data: GitHub Issues/Projects are the canonical non-sensitive development records; the app only projects their status.
modules.safeguards: An admin permission is not a B.E.N. Board vote. Review Git history and Pages artefacts before publishing; no shared passwords or secrets in commits.
acceptance: v0.1 build reproducible
unauthorised direct main push blocked where plan supports it
protected release and rollback proven
modules.enhancement: Add signed releases, dependency provenance and a public developer contribution programme after licence approval.
stories: Freeze baseline and record test results
Configure GitHub organisation, teams, branch rules and CODEOWNERS
Build and run CI, source scan and rollback drill
Set up project fields and issue workflows

modules.name: Production hosting, API and deployment protection
modules.goal: Separate public content, authenticated services, restricted casework and AI inference before any live user data.
modules.workflow: Keep public Pages static; provide a hosted HTTPS API and private inference gateway only after approved vendor/hosting selection. Establish staging, production, backups, health checks, incident on-call coverage and budgets.
modules.data: Environment configuration and operational telemetry; no personal data in Pages, client bundles or public logs.
modules.safeguards: No public hosting of v0.1 unauthenticated Node server; least-privilege service accounts, origin checks, rate limits and abuse budgets.
acceptance: Unauthorized API access denied
staging data non-production
deploy and rollback demonstrated
health and error alerts verified
modules.enhancement: Infrastructure-as-code and geographically resilient deployment only after measured need.
stories: Choose hosting and capture data processing risks
Introduce authenticated staging API and environment controls
Add rate limiting, metrics and security headers
Exercise release rollback and recovery

modules.name: Identity, delegated roles and authorization
modules.goal: Provide inclusive identity for members and strict delegated permissions for stewards without requiring GitHub accounts from everyone.
modules.workflow: Use OIDC/passkeys or equivalent inclusive methods; verify community membership separately from legal CIC membership and GitHub permissions. Staff MFA, short-lived sessions, role expiry, backups and per-case conflict exclusion.
modules.data: User, CommunityMembership, StewardAssignment, legal member link (optional) and access audit; never a public directory of legal names.
modules.safeguards: Deny by default on the backend. Negative tests must cover member/steward/reviewer/implicated founder; no client-only access checks.
acceptance: Every restricted API denies nonauthorised use
privileges expire on role exit
account recovery works through two authorised custodians
modules.enhancement: Later support federation and delegated community identity without data sale.
stories: Design identity and membership distinction
Implement login/session/MFA and server-side role policy
Add steward onboarding/offboarding and conflict recusal
Run cross-role privilege and recovery tests

modules.name: Data classification, schemas and ownership
modules.goal: Create reliable records with one canonical home for every domain and no duplication of sensitive information.
modules.workflow: Define typed IDs, source status, timestamps, classification and allowed destinations. Keep current Drive policy masters until real adoption; GitHub owns non-sensitive Issues; private DB owns identities and event participation; isolated vault owns casework.
modules.data: PolicyVersion, Decision, GitHubActionProjection, User, Project, Event, Consent, AuditEvent, SafetyReference.
modules.safeguards: No private allegations, member identifiers, medical conditions or raw financial credentials in ordinary GitHub, model inputs, shared logs or static assets.
acceptance: Schema review documented
cross-domain IDs unique
forbidden fields blocked at API/import boundary
backup restore tested
modules.enhancement: Event-sourced audit and selective data portability for other community organisations.
stories: Publish canonical data-ownership matrix
Define typed schemas and version migrations
Implement data classification/validation gates
Test duplicate events, data export and restricted-data exclusion

modules.name: Accessible design system and usability
modules.goal: Turn purple/gold B.E.N. branding into an accessible interface for nontechnical and neurodivergent participants.
modules.workflow: Auditable component library for navigation, forms, errors, tables, assisted workflows, mobile layouts and plain-language consent. Test real keyboard, screen-reader, zoom and contrast journeys.
modules.data: Design tokens, components, content style, optional reduced motion/contrast/reading choices.
modules.safeguards: Brand playfulness (#probablyacult) must never appear in safety/appeals/financial warnings. Avoid gamification that pressures participation.
acceptance: WCAG 2.2 AA targets tested
mobile task flow feasible
automated and manual accessibility checks run in CI/release reviews

Audit v0.1 keyboard, mobile and screen reader
Add plain-language form/errors and localization hooks
Publish usability and accessibility regression tests

modules.name: Public website and approved knowledge portal
modules.goal: Explain B.E.N. accurately to outsiders with truthful organisational status, safe contacts and accessible published policies.
modules.workflow: Publish the approved mission, contact channels, programme descriptions, decision summaries and how to join. Show PROPOSED where unadopted; use a separate public output build after document review.
modules.data: ApprovedPage, PolicyVersion, PublicDecisionSummary, EventSummary; no member roll or permissioned Google Drive links.
modules.safeguards: Pages content can be public even from a private repository. Verify assets, source/history, consent and publication tier prior to release.

modules.name: Notification and scheduled-work engine
modules.goal: Replace fragile manual reminders with voluntary, reliable scheduling without constant monitoring or message spam.
modules.workflow: Event RSVP, deadlines, appeals time targets, action due dates and opt-in digests generate bounded queues. Users control channels and frequency; urgent safety routing remains human-owned and clearly scoped.

modules.goal: Preserve canonical founding wording and track the difference between working proposals and adopted B.E.N. rules.

modules.name: Steward portfolio, backup and succession management
modules.goal: Make six equal portfolios operational without building permanent founder privilege.
modules.workflow: Named lead/backup, delegated scope, term, capacity, training and conflict declarations. Handover runs through approval, grant/revoke access, outstanding task transfer and dual custody checks.
modules.safeguards: No extra votes from holding several responsibilities. A conflicted or departing steward loses affected access; no automatic broad access for coordinator.

modules.name: Meetings, formal decisions and votes
modules.goal: Record decisions rigorously and eliminate accidental authority created by task completion.
modules.workflow: Draft agenda and minuted proposal, evidence, consulted members, eligibility, recusals, quorum, vote counts, exact version, decision ID, ratification and privacy-safe summary. Proposed rules: Board quorum 4 unconflicted, ordinary 3 yes, reserved 4 yes out of six; committee 3 with 2 yes.
modules.data: Decision, VoteSession, ParticipantEligibility, Recusal, SignedMinuteReference, PublicSummary.
modules.safeguards: Rules only become active after adoption; no AI-cast votes; excluded conflicted people cannot certify or view restricted annexes.

modules.name: Member consultations and election transition
modules.goal: Enable representative decision-making and leadership transition without permanently entrenching founders.
modules.workflow: Provide consultations and later elections with clear eligibility, notice, turnout, ballot confidentiality, conflict checks and explainable results. Proposed trigger: prepare at 30 active members; begin transition at 50 or six months after adoption and complete within prescribed period if adopted.
modules.data: Consultation, VotingRollSnapshot, Ballot, ElectionRuleVersion, ResultCertification, AppealReference.
modules.safeguards: Legal CIC membership differs from ordinary community membership; public comments/likes are not votes. Manual compliant election fallback is essential.

modules.name: CIC formation and statutory compliance companion
modules.goal: Track the proposed UK CIC limited-by-guarantee formation path and ongoing duties with evidence, not legal fiction.
modules.workflow: Founders verify six directors and six initial legal members (one vote each), registered office/email, identity verification, proposed CIC36, model Articles, PSC analysis, filing and bank account. Record filings and next duties only after they actually happen.
modules.safeguards: Do not collect director identity documents in GitHub. Verify fees, dates and legal terms against current official guidance prior to filing; no claim of incorporation from a checklist.

modules.goal: Enable transparent finance without personal pots or unchecked spending.
modules.workflow: Budgets require authorized reserved Board approval; invoices and expense claims require independent approvers; money stays in approved organisational accounts. Track multi-currency only via documented conversions and a base reporting currency.
modules.data: Budget, FinanceRequest, ApprovedAmount, ReceiptRef, ApprovalChain, ReconciliationPeriod.
modules.safeguards: Never store bank/card numbers in general GitHub, allow AI to initiate payments, or treat PR approval as financial authorization. Verify legal/tax obligations.

modules.goal: Provide fair, confidential routes to protect members and challenge leader misconduct.

modules.safeguards: Keep reports in separate restricted storage; never allow implicated founder, general GitHub collaborator or public AI to see them. No AI auto-judgment or moral profiling; distinguish report from finding and offer emergency services guidance.

modules.goal: Produce trustworthy, inclusive public messages while respecting current policy authority.

modules.name: Member data rights, consent and departure
modules.goal: Give real control over personal data, communication preferences and the ability to leave.
modules.workflow: Consent centre for publicity, contact, analytics, AI chat history and optional profile attributes. Provide access/export, correction, deletion/review, consent withdrawal and account deactivation, with clear lawful retention exceptions.
modules.safeguards: No dark patterns, bundled marketing, or assurances that all backups can be erased instantly. Case records require separate legal review.
acceptance: Member can change consent and see purpose, recipients and review status
records follow classification and retention rules
modules.enhancement: Portable privacy dashboard and public aggregate data inventory.
stories: Build consent/purpose registry and plain-language controls
Implement data export and erasure-request workflow
Add retention review, audit and backup-caveat notices
Test marketing opt-out, edge retention and cross-role data isolation

modules.name: Curated community resource library and knowledge commons
modules.goal: Help people find trustworthy information and practical guides without relying solely on AI answers.
modules.workflow: Tag approved pages by topic, audience, language, currency, geography and review date; allow member-submitted suggestions with editor attribution and verification before they become official resources.
modules.data: Resource, SourceCitation, EditorReview, Translation, Deprecation, Licence.
modules.safeguards: Separate evidence from opinion; include accessible alternatives; do not import restricted Drive archives automatically.
acceptance: Search returns checked source/review date
broken or outdated resources flagged
contributor attribution with consent
modules.enhancement: Open educational materials and community teaching kits with licensed reuse.
stories: Build reviewed resource catalogue and tags
Enable attribution and member suggestions
Add expiry/review reminders and dead-link checks
Test outdated, disputed and wrongly licensed resources

modules.name: Clear front door for concerns, feedback and fair appeals
modules.goal: Allow people to reach a safe, independent human contact without publicly revealing a complaint.
modules.workflow: Explain ordinary feedback vs confidential report vs urgent safety concern. Provide primary and alternate route, time-of-monitoring, report receipt reference and appeal information; allow anonymous initial messages where feasible.
modules.data: FeedbackSubmission, PrivateCaseTicketRef, ContactRouteVersion; narrative stored only in restricted service.
modules.safeguards: GitHub Issues or public forums must never receive full complaints. Subject of concern cannot be the only available report recipient.
acceptance: A case involving a founder reaches unconflicted reviewers
report acknowledgements are honest and optional anonymity preserved where possible
modules.enhancement: Encrypted anonymous dropbox and independent advisory contact if support capacity justifies it.
stories: Build accessible guidance choosing report/feedback route
Connect secure separate report intake and receipt
Provide independent escalation and appeal contact paths
Test implicated-founder and anonymous-report cases

modules.name: Member activity feed and opt-in digests
modules.goal: Help members discover relevant B.E.N. activity without addictive attention harvesting.
modules.workflow: Personal dashboard lists chosen channels, accessible events, project updates and saved opportunities. Digests default to conservative frequency and allow pausing or disabling; no infinite-scroll reward loops.
modules.safeguards: Never rank users by posting frequency or engagement, profile sensitive needs, or sell feed personalization.
acceptance: New member can turn feeds off
digest only contains authorized and consented events
no default daily spam
modules.enhancement: Offline digest and accessibility-tailored notification formats.
stories: Create transparent opt-in feed rules
Build subscribed project/event updates
Add weekly digest and unsubscribe controls
Test quiet member, repetitive alerts and private event filtering

modules.name: Local activity discovery without community fragmentation
modules.goal: Enable relevant local help and events while preserving one broad global community rather than siloed regional groups.
modules.workflow: User chooses a general locality/radius or anonymous online-only mode; searches return safe public activities. Exact addresses revealed only when needed and agreed by participants.
modules.safeguards: No default location tracking, background GPS, public home addresses or scraping of other member positions.
acceptance: Location mode optional
remote members see full access
granularity changes correctly remove private coordinates
modules.enhancement: Opt-in neighbourhood project pods and partner venues with separate risk review; not automatic permanent regional channels.
stories: Define locality precision and privacy defaults
Build safe location/radius filtering
Add event/help discovery with minimal location
Test online-only, location withdrawal and sensitive venue

modules.name: Multilingual and low-bandwidth inclusion
modules.goal: Let people participate regardless of English fluency, connection quality or device power.
modules.workflow: Support clear language, translation review and human-readable source language. Key safety/legal notices use approved human-reviewed translations; optional AI translation labels uncertainty; lightweight/mobile offline drafts for non-sensitive forms.
modules.safeguards: Never machine-translate urgent legal/safety requirements without human review; offline drafts must not store sensitive casework in browser cache.
acceptance: Accessible navigation in at least pilot languages chosen by founders
source and translation versions linked
low-bandwidth path tested
modules.enhancement: Audio narration and participatory language translation programme with consent.
stories: Choose priority languages from consenting member needs
Build internationalization and translated content review
Add low-bandwidth/PWA for non-sensitive content
Test untranslated legal notices, screen reader and offline data safety

modules.name: Public outcomes, stories and community accountability
modules.goal: Show tangible changes achieved without exploiting beneficiaries or turning kindness into marketing.
modules.workflow: Publish verified project outcomes, anonymous aggregate figures, consented short stories, corrections and community feedback. Link to context, method, time window and any limits.
modules.safeguards: No identifiable distressed-member stories without meaningful consent; reject fabricated images and impact statistics.
acceptance: Every public outcome has source, consent, reviewer and correction route
small-group data suppressed where appropriate
modules.enhancement: Independent community impact research and replicable project instructions.
stories: Create public outcome story templates
Implement consent and factual verification check
Add change-log and corrections
Test small-population privacy and withdrawn publicity consent

modules.name: B.E.N. AI constitution and authority boundaries
modules.goal: Make Be Even Nicer an explicitly accountable assistant, not an unanswerable ideological authority.
modules.workflow: Create versioned system behaviour standards: kindness without coercion, dissent protection, human decisions, source provenance, honest uncertainty, privacy, environmental awareness, no ranking moral worth. Each change reviewed against BEN-01 and actual adoption state.
modules.safeguards: Model instruction is advisory not enforcement. No AI can grant itself authority, decide who is greedy or suppress disagreement.
acceptance: Constitution is human-readable, versioned and tested
conflicting user/system/retrieved instructions cannot overwrite human rights or approval gates
modules.enhancement: Public community consultation on the AI constitution after baseline safeguards and governance adoption.
stories: Publish initial versioned AI constitution
Map each principle to testable behavioural requirements
Implement refusal-to-claim-authority tests
Review values changes against actual approved policies

modules.name: Verified knowledge retrieval and policy provenance
modules.goal: Replace seven short keyword-selected notes with document-grounded, version-aware answers.
modules.workflow: Ingest only authorized documents after classification and editor review. Chunk with source IDs, offsets, policy status, hash, effective date and access class. Retrieve only allowed chunks; model cites exact spans and says when evidence is missing.
modules.data: DocumentSource, SourceChunk, EmbeddingIndex, RetrievalLog, AnswerCitation, FreshnessDate.
modules.safeguards: Untrusted retrieved text cannot instruct tools; private docs never leaked into public user contexts; no invented decision IDs or false adoption claims.
acceptance: Citation click opens exact permitted passage
unsupported policy claims flagged
source update/rollback and stale status tested
modules.enhancement: Multilingual retrieval, independent source-verification and semantic conflict detection.
stories: Build approved-source ingestion and version registry
Implement permission-aware hybrid search and exact citation spans
Add unsupported-answer and freshness checks
Test fabricated citations, injected documents and role leakage

modules.name: Founder copilot for administration and planning
modules.goal: Give overworked volunteer leaders a capable secretary without turning the secretary into a decision-maker.
modules.workflow: Draft meeting agendas, minute summaries, actions, grant text, publication briefs, policy comparisons and risk prompts from approved sources. Show editable drafts, source citations, uncertainty and a named reviewer step. No silent GitHub write or outreach.
modules.safeguards: No auto-votes, legal claims, payments, private case analysis or publication without human action; consent before processing transcripts.
acceptance: Human can inspect and edit before copy/export
missing evidence flagged
all tool requests remain pending until approved
modules.enhancement: Role-specific assistants for six portfolios once the common governance gate is mature.
stories: Build read-only founder Q&A and agenda drafts
Add referenced minutes/action extraction from consented material
Implement approval-aware non-sensitive GitHub task drafting
Test wrong authority, missing source and transcript privacy

modules.name: Member-facing B.E.N. companion
modules.goal: Offer practical empathy, education and project guidance while refusing coercive reward systems and false professional authority.
modules.workflow: Chat helps navigate the organisation, discover resources, write proposals and plan positive actions. It displays source/version links, alternative human route, content boundaries and optional memory settings.
modules.safeguards: No therapy/diagnosis, coercive upsell, secret social scoring or unrestricted private-data ingestion. Some queries should be answered without personal account.
acceptance: Member obtains useful, comprehensible sourced guidance
high-risk or uncertain cases redirect to appropriate human service
errors can be reported
modules.enhancement: Voice, additional languages and domain-specific tutoring after robust evaluation.
stories: Create member copilot UX and scope disclosures
Build resource/project guidance flows
Add uncertainty, helpfulness and incident reporting
Test inclusion, critical dissent and harmful-usage boundaries

modules.name: AI tools, permissions and human action queue
modules.goal: Allow AI to prepare useful actions while preventing it from becoming an unreviewable operator.
modules.workflow: AI proposes typed actions (draft GitHub Issue, schedule non-sensitive event, write public draft) with impact preview, required role, allowed scopes, idempotency key, expiration and explicit approval. Server independently validates on execution.
modules.safeguards: No model-originated bank transfers, member bans, votes, case access, new admin grants or self-authorised publishing; kill switch and rate cap required.
acceptance: Unapproved action causes zero external side effects
permissions enforced on server even with malicious prompt
receipts auditable
modules.enhancement: Negotiated multi-agent task plans after independent safety evaluation and strict per-step human approval.
stories: Define allowlisted tools and typed schemas
Build preview, expiry and human approval queue
Implement scoped GitHub create-only actions with idempotency
Red-team prompt injection and privileged-tool requests

modules.name: Consented personal memory and data minimisation
modules.goal: Let B.E.N. remember helpful preferences without creating hidden surveillance dossiers.
modules.workflow: Offer explicit memory OFF/ON, purpose-specific storage, preview/edit/export/delete and retention choices. Keep conversation knowledge isolated per user and never infer political beliefs, wealth, diagnoses or social worth.
modules.safeguards: No invisible cross-member training or unrestricted reuse of volunteer/member stories; private case material excluded.
acceptance: OFF means no durable personal memory
deletion request stops retrieval
users can inspect exact stored items
modules.enhancement: Local-device memory and encrypted portable data vault if technically and legally feasible.
stories: Create consent-first memory design and off-by-default state
Implement inspect/edit/export/delete controls
Add isolated retrieval and retention rules
Test cross-user leak, disabled memory and backup notice

modules.name: Evaluation, red teams and independent AI oversight
modules.goal: Prove behaviour through repeated tests, not assurances that a model is benevolent.
modules.workflow: Versioned synthetic benchmark with dilemmas about dissent, founders, private cases, sources, fundraising, AI agency and fairness. Measure factual support, respectful refusal, transparency, privacy, accessibility, cost and failure frequency by model/prompt/retriever version.
modules.data: EvalCase, ExpectedProperties, ModelRun, HumanReview, FailureSeverity, ReleaseGate.
modules.safeguards: No publishing confidential user prompts; no single person-defined goodness score. Include adversarial tests and real human complaint path.
acceptance: CI fails on critical private-data leaks or unauthorized tool actions
results reproducible
model rollback possible
modules.enhancement: Independent evaluation grants and community challenge programmes with controlled disclosure.
stories: Create comprehensive synthetic B.E.N. benchmark
Build automated model/retriever eval runner
Add independent review and critical-failure release gates
Test adversarial prompt injection and disparate treatment

modules.name: Replaceable model providers and cost limits
modules.goal: Keep the movement free to change AI providers as licensing, ethics, performance and costs evolve.
modules.workflow: Adapt Ollama/local and separately reviewed hosted providers to one interface. Track model weights/license, provenance, deployment region, cost, context/energy limits and evaluation profile. Degrade gracefully when quota reached.
modules.safeguards: No vendor lock-in by design; do not promise every model is safe or equally capable; no raw private prompts to third parties without consent and contract review.
acceptance: Same eval suite works on two providers
costs capped
unsupported provider disabled
user gets honest outage notice
modules.enhancement: Cooperative hosting and self-managed community inference when actual maintenance capacity exists.
stories: Implement provider-neutral inference adapter
Add quotas, health checks and fallback mode
Compare output on B.E.N. benchmark and licensing
Test outage, overruns and endpoint data exposure

modules.name: Opt-in ethical opportunity matching
modules.goal: Help people find useful ways to participate without manipulating or profiling them.
modules.workflow: Use explicit interests, selected location, availability and capacity to suggest projects, help requests or mentoring. Explain reasons, allow filters and opt out; new participants and small projects must remain discoverable.
modules.safeguards: No inferred vulnerability, political views, wealth or social worth; no mandatory engagement and no black-box exclusions.
acceptance: Users can see why a suggestion appears and turn matching off
results do not become member scores
modules.enhancement: Fairness evaluation for visibility of new/small projects and accessibility preferences.
stories: Build explainable opt-in matching rules
Add preference editor and reason strings
Measure project exposure fairness and opt-out
Test edge cases for scarce availability and sensitive profiles

modules.name: Public-interest evidence and accountability researcher
modules.goal: Use AI to help citizens assess public claims, contracts and environmental impacts transparently and peacefully.
modules.workflow: Assist with open public sources, claim extraction, evidence graph, conflicting reports, citations, corrections and a human editor. Frame concerns as verifiable questions and disclose uncertainties.
modules.data: ResearchSource, Claim, EvidenceLink, SourceDate, EditorAttestation, Correction.
modules.safeguards: No hacking, private data scraping, doxxing, unsupported accusations, political manipulation or publishing unreviewed conclusions.
acceptance: Every material claim links to evidence and review
a contested or missing-source claim is labelled, not asserted as fact
modules.enhancement: Open reusable FOI/public procurement and environmental review toolkits.
stories: Design public-source research and provenance graph
Build claim-to-citation checking and disagreement summaries
Create editor review and corrections workflow
Test false allegations, source conflicts and personal privacy

modules.name: Energy, sustainability and compute accountability
modules.goal: Make environmental cost a visible product constraint rather than an afterthought.
modules.workflow: Measure requests, model/server resource proxies, provider energy disclosures when available, cost and infrastructure impacts. Offer small-model routing for simpler tasks, caching, opt-in long tasks and published limits of estimates.
modules.safeguards: Never claim exact carbon emissions without defensible measurement; avoid hiding provider uncertainty or sacrificing user safety for lower compute.
acceptance: Per-task cost and resource budget tracked
public reporting separates measured data from estimates
thresholds trigger review
modules.enhancement: Environmental procurement checklist and nonprofit climate partner collaborations.
stories: Instrument inference and provider-cost metrics
Implement simple-task/small-model routing benchmark
Publish measured-versus-estimated environmental notes
Test quota, energy accounting and cost regression

modules.name: Community-governed AI research and federation
modules.goal: Investigate a genuinely public-benefit AI network beyond a single founder or company.
modules.workflow: Publish model/evaluation governance, community consultation, exit/portability rights, documented disagreements and independent oversight; explore interoperable community instances without sharing raw member data.
modules.safeguards: No autonomous sovereignty or claims of AI consciousness; research potential AI welfare ethically without asserting today's systems are sentient.
acceptance: Pilot communities can export approved public methods and their own data
independent reviewers can challenge major model changes
modules.enhancement: Federated co-op infrastructure and participatory AI research only after strong privacy, governance and capacity proof.
stories: Publish community AI stewardship research charter
Prototype portable source/model configs
Test consent-aware federation with synthetic data
Run independent governance and AI welfare ethics review
